text: The village battle ended when a distant church bell rang, triggering an immediate hypnotic trance that made the Ganados drop their weapons and leave.
The church bell's effect was proof that the cult leadership used a telepathic frequency to control the infected population as a single mind.
Salazar Castle features mechanized walls, fire-breathing stone statues, deep pits, and spike-line traps designed to isolate intruders.
Leon Kennedy used the glass eye recovered from Bitores Mendez to bypass a biometric security gate and enter the castle.
Leon Kennedy discovered that removing an Armadura's helmet and using a flash grenade was the reliable way to destroy the exposed parasite.
Osmund Saddler used the dominant species Plaga to issue mental commands that bypassed an infected host's willpower, including Ashley Graham's.
Ramon Salazar's biological connection to the castle network made the Queen Plaga a primary node in the cult's telepathic frequency.
Ada Wong used her technical skills to disable security sensors so the speedboat could approach the island undetected.
Leon Kennedy used a thermal scope to locate and destroy the individual parasites hidden inside each Regenerator's body to kill them permanently.
Leon Kennedy and Ashley Graham used the laser device to remove their own Plagas, restoring their autonomy and ending Saddler's ability to telepathically control them.
